query:
Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
---
name: "Check for Dependencies Updates"

on:
  ## Check for dependencies update daily, at 00:00 UTC
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  ## Check for updatecli configuration with the "diff" command when new code is pushed
  push:
  pull_request:
  ## When run manually for validation purpose, or "retrying a failed build"
  workflow_dispatch:
# Only allow 1 updatecli build at a time to avoid orphaned updatecli branches
concurrency: "updatecli"
jobs:
  updatecli:
    if: github.repository_owner == 'asciidoctor' || github.event_name != 'schedule'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      # Extract the repo and owner values to feed to updatecli through env. variables
      - id: get-repo-infos
        name: Get Repository Informations
        run: |
          owner=$(echo $GITHUB_REPOSITORY | cut -d'/' -f1)
          repo=$(echo $GITHUB_REPOSITORY | cut -d'/' -f2)
          echo "owner=$owner" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "repo=$repo" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
      - name: Setup Updatecli
        uses: updatecli/updatecli-action@v3.10.0
      ## Ensure that the updatecli configurations are valid without waiting for the daily execution from the workflow "Updatecli"
      - name: Diff
        ## Check the updatecli syntax on each code change
        if: github.event_name != 'schedule' && github.ref != 'refs/heads/main'
        run: updatecli pipeline diff --config ./updatecli/updatecli.d --values ./updatecli/values.yaml
        env:
          ## Use GITHUB_TOKEN for diff as any external contributor will have one allowed to read GitHub API
          UPDATECLI_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          REPO_NAME: ${{steps.get-repo-infos.outputs.repo}}
          REPO_OWNER: ${{steps.get-repo-infos.outputs.owner}}
      ## When on principal branch, generate a temporary token to allow starting/modifying workflows
      # Not using a PAT to avoid depending on a GitHub account
      - name: Generate token
        id: generate_token
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@64ab729a6294000f5aa4a4bc0b73d1f32bc45510 # v3
        with:
          client-id: ${{ secrets.UPDATECLIBOT_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.UPDATECLIBOT_APP_PRIVKEY }}
      - name: Apply
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        run: updatecli apply --config ./updatecli/updatecli.d --values ./updatecli/values.yaml
        env:
          ## Use generated token to allow writes on the GitHub API / starting fresh PRs workflows
          UPDATECLI_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.generate_token.outputs.token }}
          REPO_NAME: ${{steps.get-repo-infos.outputs.repo}}
          REPO_OWNER: ${{steps.get-repo-infos.outputs.owner}}
...

Suppress schedules during repository inactivity

Pattern: P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE (scheduled_run_reduction)

When is suppress schedules during repository inactivity applicable?

Assess suppress schedules during repository inactivity for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Periodic results depend only on repository changes

Contraindications: External dependencies, security or time-based requirements need fresh checks

Method: Identify meaningful activity rather than generated self-updates; Resume when relevant inputs change

Reported finding: Inactivity suppression saves some scheduled work.

Reported metrics: {"paid_scheduled_vm_time_reduction_percent": 1.1}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.3.2; Table 5; PDF pp. 8, 9: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf
